description: Assumptions for the per-product TAM and valuation model (HIC 25.09.2026: "Arvioi truth registry TAM kullekin tuotteelle ja tee sitten valuaatio kullekin tuotteelle"). Rendered by scripts/truth/product-valuation.mjs into docs/truth/PRODUCT_VALUATION.md. Every number here is either sourced in the repo (status sourced, with the file) or a model estimate to verify before any investor use (status estimate). Change a number here, never in the generated file.

method.tam: Bottom-up per product: buyers in the product's segment x fit (share of the segment the product is for) x annual value per buyer. Annual value: recurring price x 12 (monthly) or x 1 (yearly); hourly price x hoursPerYear; one-time price / replacementCycleYears.
method.som: Year-5 obtainable revenue = TAM x the product family's year-5 capture share.
method.value: Present value = year-5 revenue x family revenue multiple x family probability of reaching it / (1 + discountRate)^5. Low and high cases halve and double the capture share.
method.discountRateBasis: Venture hurdle rate for a pre-revenue software company (common 30-50 % range; lower bound used because two paid pilots exist, docs/TRACTION_CANONICAL.md).

FI_SME.label: Finnish enterprises outside primary production (micro and small dominate)
FI_SME.basis: Order of magnitude of the Statistics Finland business register; verify the current count before use.

EU_CSRD_LARGE.label: EU companies in CSRD scope after Omnibus I (>1,000 employees and >EUR 450M turnover)
EU_CSRD_LARGE.basis: DWS_TRUTH_STANDARD.md regulatory-scope row 2026-06-29: fewer than 5,000 large companies.

EU_INDUSTRIAL.label: EU manufacturing, energy and process-industry enterprises with 250+ employees
EU_INDUSTRIAL.basis: Order of magnitude of Eurostat structural business statistics; verify.

EU_EDGE_SITES.label: Industrial sites of EU_INDUSTRIAL enterprises that can host edge AI (about 3 sites per enterprise)

EU_MIDLARGE.label: EU enterprises with 250+ employees, all sectors
EU_MIDLARGE.basis: Order of magnitude of Eurostat enterprise-size statistics; verify.

EU_REGULATED.label: EU defence, public-sector and critical-infrastructure bodies that need sovereign or air-gapped AI
EU_REGULATED.basis: Model estimate; verify against NIS2 essential-entity and EDIP participant counts.

sme.basis: Campaign live in Finland; services-type margin, so revenue multiple 1x.

dwsiq.basis: Recurring software; 6x revenue is a mid multiple for private B2B SaaS; pre-revenue apart from two pilots.

aegis.basis: Small named segment, higher capture; preorder, GA September 2026, pre-revenue (docs/TRACTION_CANONICAL.md).

firehorse.basis: Agent products, mixed one-time and recurring.

hardware.basis: Resale with installation; value is margin, not revenue.

infra.basis: Kubernetes, NIM, DOCA, Gov Ready service and subscription SKUs on edge sites.

repo.capitalisedSource: same file, account 1030 Kehittamismenot, entries 1 and 2
repo.loadedCostBasis: Estimate for a senior software engineer in Finland including employer costs; verify.
repo.aiProductivityBasis: Model assumption: an AI-assisted team rebuilds 3-5x faster than COCOMO's traditional-team baseline; verify against the repo's own commit throughput.

priorValuations.source: Gust, independent; DWS platform value only (HIC 25.09.2026)
